process_description: The De-C5 unit separates C5 and lighter components from the incoming feed stream by preheating the feed, feeding it to De-C5 Tower T-00, providing reboil duty through bottom reboiler E-05, removing bottoms liquid through the bottom pump system, and returning/recovering overhead reflux through the condenser, reflux drum, and reflux subcooler system. Feed flow to the tower is controlled by FIC-001 at an assumed normal feed rate of 100 ton/hr. Tower pressure is controlled by PIC-002, with assumed operating pressures of 8.0 barg at the top and 8.5 barg at the bottom. Tower temperature is controlled through TIC-012 acting on the reboiler E-05 heat input, with assumed operating temperatures of 55 °C at the top and 150 °C at the bottom. Bottom composition is intended to contain no more than 1.0 wt% lighter C5, and overhead liquid is intended to contain no more than 1.0 wt% C5.
intention: The intention of the De-C5 system is to strip C5 and lighter components from the feed stream at a controlled feed rate using the De-C5 Tower T-00 and associated heat-integration, reboiling, bottom product, and reflux systems. The unit is intended to maintain stable feed preheating through E-02 and E-03A/B, stable fractionation in T-00, adequate vapor generation by reboiler E-05, controlled tower pressure by PIC-002, controlled tower temperature by TIC-012, controlled tower level by LIC-001 via FV-002, adequate bottom pump circulation and minimum flow through FV-005, and stable reflux return through the overhead condenser/reflux drum/subcooler system. The intended product quality is lighter C5 at the bottom not exceeding 1.0 wt% and C5 in the overhead liquid not exceeding 1.0 wt%, under assumed normal operating conditions of 100 ton/hr feed, 8.0 barg top pressure, 8.5 barg bottom pressure, 55 °C top temperature, and 150 °C bottom temperature.

connections.node_boundary: Includes the preheat feed line through E-02 and E-03A/B, the De-C5 Tower T-00, and bottom reboiler E-05. The node covers feed flow control, feed preheating, tower fractionation, pressure control, level control interface, and reboiler heat input.
connections.flow_direction: Feed flows through FV-001 to E-02, then through E-03A/B for preheating, and then into T-00. Bottom liquid from T-00 circulates through reboiler E-05, where medium-pressure steam provides heat input through FV-003. Vapor-liquid separation occurs inside T-00, with overhead vapor leaving the tower and bottoms liquid leaving toward the bottom system.
connections.context: Grouped HAZOP reasoning node for the main De-C5 tower fractionation function. This node allows causes in feed control, feed preheating, pressure control, reboiler duty, tower temperature, and tower level to be reasoned against consequences such as loss of separation, tower warming/cooling, pressure increase, pressure decrease, high level, low level, off-spec overhead, off-spec bottom product, relief demand, and downstream feed instability.

connections.node_boundary: Starts from outlet HV-001 at the bottom of T-00 and from FV-005 on the minimum-flow line of the bottom pumps. Ends at FV-002 on the bottom outlet to downstream process. Includes bottom pumps P-06A/B and tube-side service of E-03A/B.
connections.to_id: De-C5 bottom product to downstream process
connections.flow_direction: Bottom liquid leaves T-00 through HV-001, flows to bottom pumps P-06A/B, then flows through the bottom heat-recovery path associated with E-03A/B tube side, and exits to the downstream process through FV-002. A minimum-flow line controlled by FV-005 returns or circulates flow for pump protection.
connections.context: Grouped HAZOP reasoning node for bottom product removal, bottom pump protection, heat-recovery service, and downstream bottom outlet control. This node supports reasoning for no flow, less flow, high flow, reverse flow, pump loss of suction, pump deadheading, high tower level due to blocked bottom outlet, low tower level due to excessive bottom withdrawal, bottom product off-specification, and loss of downstream feed.

connections.node_boundary: Starts from T-00 overhead and includes the overhead condenser / De-C5 fan cooler system, reflux drum, reflux subcoolers E-04A/B, and reflux return line to T-00. The reflux drum is part of the intended node boundary even though it is not shown in the provided figure.
connections.flow_direction: Overhead vapor leaves the top of T-00 and flows to the condenser / fan cooler system. Condensed liquid flows to the reflux drum, then through reflux subcoolers E-04A/B. Part of the cooled liquid returns to T-00 as reflux, while the overhead product leaves the reflux system.
connections.context: Grouped HAZOP reasoning node for overhead condensation, reflux accumulation, reflux cooling, and reflux return to T-00. This node supports reasoning for insufficient reflux, excessive reflux, blocked overhead path, condenser underperformance, reflux drum level upset, poor subcooling, pressure instability, off-spec overhead product, and loss of tower separation efficiency.
